notes: We started and ended the year with eight people. Two left and two joined. I spoke with the one who resigned twice and couldn't keep her, which is something I need to look at. The person I most want to mention is He Jiawen: she built the carrier channel on the ground, was promoted to team lead mid-year, and now has two reports. Gu Xiaofeng joined in April, shadowed the chain stores for three months, and has run 40 stores on his own since July.
